status: Research-only original-source assessment; no catalogue, image, orbit or licence adoption.

targetedFindings.observation: 2010-02-23 UT SINFONI H+K 1.45–2.45 micron R~1500; appulse UCAC2 29643541 at 4 arcsec, program 284.C-5044. 150s integrations smear the moving target; elongated PSF is not a measured body shape.
targetedFindings.componentSeparation: Vanth colours slightly redder with large uncertainties; Orcus crystalline water, 2.2 micron band and methane/ethane/ammonia limits must not be assigned to Vanth.
targetedFindings.historicalDateCorrection: Authors explicitly report earlier Brown2010 HST dates offset by half a day, confirmed by personal communication; Table astrometry lists corrected JD values. This is a published claim, not independent reprocessing or a blanket correction of all archive timestamps.
targetedFindings.astrometry: Nine corrected HST rows plus SINFONI JD2455250.73686, east/north offsets .260/.052 arcsec. Time-scale/raw exposure crosswalk remains open.
targetedFindings.orbit: Statistical Keplerian inversion: a9030±89km, e.007±.003, P9.5406±.0004d, tangent-plane i±21±2deg, node144±63deg. Pole A ECJ2000(321,-2), B(340,+38), both ±3deg; mirror B not excluded. Formal errors omit possible systematic model incompleteness including unknown Orcus J2. Not current ephemeris or independently reproduced fit.
targetedFindings.physicalModels: System mass641±19 x10^18kg; historical Vanth diameter267 or378±100km conditional albedos, distinct later thermal475±75 and occultation443±10. Not local normal, axes, chemistry or visible-map calibration.
targetedFindings.rotation: Synchronous rotation, equator alignment and tidal circularization are interpretations; Kozai alternative allows large mutual tilt. No measured moon spin or guaranteed permanent primary-facing scene.
targetedFindings.processing: SINFONI pipeline2.0.5 bad-pixel/flat/sky/wavelength calibration, 27 February and9 March cubes. Figure caption February23 total4050s separates components; March13 total5400s lower angular resolution hides Vanth in background. Non-detection in March is not disappearance, atmospheric absence or surface change. No figure adopted.
